text:
marco: Quick sync — launching next week. Need X thread + LinkedIn post + webinar bump assets. Target: demo signups and benchmark narrative. Can we lock copy + hero by EOD Wed?

eva: I can draft the thread structure. Will do 4 tweets: hook, metric tease, short quote from benchmark, CTA to webinar.

sam g: For timing, leaning Tuesday 10am PT for X, Wed 9am PT for LinkedIn; agrees on webinar bump same day as LinkedIn.

marco: Thanks. Can you add UTM examples? We need to route inbound signups by campaign to SDRs.

nathan (growth): Use utm_source=x, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=launch_q2; for tweet-level split add utm_content=a or b. Example: https://redwood.ai/demo?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=a

claire: Asset ask: hero 1200x628 PNG, 1 short clip (15s mp4) for socials, and a 1080x1080 carousel frame. Is there an existing benchmark chart we can reuse?

eva: I'll pull the benchmark chart from the research drive and simplify for hero. Need the high-res export by tomorrow.

marco: Also need two copy variants for the LinkedIn long post: (A) product-first with benchmark numbers, (B) customer story angle. Keep both ~120-140 words.

ben (ops): For SDR routing, what's the rule? We can route by utm_content or by form hidden field.

marco: Route by utm_content: a -> SDR Team A, b -> SDR Team B. Also flag anyone who clicks webinar CTA and reaches the /demo thanks page for immediate follow-up.

nathan (growth): I'll set the campaign in GA and add a webhook from the form to forward to the SDR queue with the utm_content tag.

sam g: Draft thread copy — short and testable: 1) "Benchmark: Open LLM serving costs 3x lower with smart batching — here's how we measured it." 2) "Webinar Thurs: See the tests + live Q&A — register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=a" 3) quote tweet: "Latency and cost matter. We tested 5 configs — results inside." 4) CTA with link. Thoughts?

eva: Love it. For A/B we'll change the hook and CTA tone. Variant B is more "customer-first": "How Acme cut serving costs by 60% — their approach + benchmark results."

claire: Creative notes: hero should show the benchmark chart + headline overlay. For the 15s clip we'll animate the chart and drop in the CTA at 10s. Export specs: H.264, 1080p, 30fps.

marco: Scheduler ask: can we queue X thread as a thread (no auto-link-shortener) and pin the first tweet? Also schedule replies for first 6 hours to boost engagement.

ben (ops): We can schedule thread + pinned first tweet. For reply push, we can set up auto-responders from the brand account with templated replies. Will need approved templates.

marco: Templates: 1) "Thanks for the note — would you like a quick demo?" 2) "Appreciate the shout — we've got a webinar Thurs, join here: <link>" 3) "Here's the benchmark slide: <link to drive>" Keep them short and include CTA.

nathan (growth): I'll create UTM-tagged shortlinks and deliver a CSV mapping utm_content -> SDR queue. Example CSV lines:
```
utm_content,sdre_team
A,SDR_A
B,SDR_B
```

eva: Also request: can marketing ops surface 3 top comments for a follow-up Stories highlight? We should capture handles of high-value accounts.

sam g: Good call — we'll compile top 20 engaged handles in the first 24h and hand to community for outreach.

marco: Timeline recap: Tue 10am PT X thread live, Wed 9am PT LinkedIn long post + hero, Wed webinar bump midday, Thurs webinar. Deliverables: hero + clip + 2 LinkedIn variants + 4 tweet thread variants + approved reply templates + UTM links.

claire: I'll upload hero + clip to the drive by Tue 8am PT.

ben (ops): I'll set up the routing webhook and test with a staging submission by Tue afternoon.

nathan (growth): I'll deliver the UTM shortlinks and CSV by Tue 3pm PT.

scheduler-bot: Scheduled: X thread (1730020000), LinkedIn post (1730090000).

marco: Awesome. Quick ask — can someone draft two 1-liners for paid copy? Need them for small promote budget.

eva: Draft: A) "Cut LLM serving costs 3x without sacrificing latency — free benchmark + live webinar." B) "See how teams scale LLMs reliably — join our benchmark webinar Thurs."

sam g: I'll run a quick a/b on paid creative with those lines and report CTR by end of week. :thumbsup:

marco: Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll follow up Wed morning with final checklist. :rocket:
